data_fields.name: same_cue_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: MAX_SAME_SAMPLES = 2 (third same-cue copy in radius refused)

data_fields.name: cue_audible_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: range per cue entry in audio.json; 1800 in all 357 entries

data_fields.name: repeat_cooldown
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 in realTime units (unit not read); build-fail cue only

best_idea: Refuse, do not queue or steal: a cue is dropped when more than two copies of it already sit within the cue's own radius of the new source, which caps the stack in a many-on-one fight.
decision_why: The same-cue cap with a per-cue radius fits three attackers stacking hits on one target, but Frankendom needs one radius per cue (the donor splits the cap radius and the zero-gain distance), float maths, and a priority bypass for telegraphs and finishers that the donor does not have.
acceptance: In a three-on-one fight the hit sound stacks at most three times at one spot; a fourth identical hit within the radius is dropped while a boss telegraph cue still plays (proposed bypass).
